annotations.title: Decode and checksum-audit a PIX copy-and-paste BRCode

description: Parses an existing PIX copy-and-paste string, verifies its CRC16-CCITT checksum against the payload, and extracts the PIX key, receiver name and city, amount, description and country code from the EMVCo tags. Use it before paying to confirm a code was not altered in transit, to reconcile an inbound charge, or to extract the counterparty key for a KYB check. Do not use it to create a charge (use br_generate_pix_brcode). Deterministic, read-only and fully offline: no bank or external service is contacted, so decoding proves the code is internally consistent but says nothing about whether the key is active or the charge is legitimate. Costs 0.01 USDC per call via x402 v2 on Base (eip155:8453) or a B2B X-API-Key; an unpaid call returns HTTP 402 with a PAYMENT-REQUIRED header. A tampered or truncated code is a normal result, not an error: the call returns success:true with valid:false and both the provided and the recomputed checksum so the mismatch can be audited, and tags the payload omits come back as null rather than raising an exception.

brcode.description: The full PIX copy-and-paste string, normally starting with '000201' and containing the '6304' checksum tag. It must be at least 20 characters long and include '6304', otherwise the payload is reported as malformed. Pass the raw string, not a QR image.

name: br_decode_pix_brcode

error.description: Stable machine-readable failure code, present only when the call itself was rejected. Common values: 'bad_request' (malformed JSON or no operation supplied), 'invalid_payment' / 'settlement_failed' (x402 verification or settlement refused, returned with HTTP 402), 'B2B_KEY_INVALID' and 'B2B_QUOTA_EXCEEDED' (B2B X-API-Key path), 'invalid_wafermap_signature' (marketplace HMAC path). A document that simply fails validation is NOT an error: the call returns success:true with valid:false inside the result block.

message.description: Human-readable explanation of the failure, in Portuguese. Safe to log or surface to a human operator.

pixDecoded.description: The decoded payload. Check valid before trusting any extracted field.

amountBRL.description: Charge amount in BRL from EMVCo tag 54. Null for an open-value code the payer fills in.

calculatedCrc.description: The checksum recomputed from the payload. Differing from providedCrc is the signature of a tampered or truncated code.

countryCode.description: Country code from EMVCo tag 58, defaulting to 'BR'.

crcValid.description: Same verdict as valid, exposed separately for callers that branch on checksum integrity alone.

description.description: Free-text note from EMVCo subtag 26-02. Null when absent.

error.description: Portuguese reason, present only when the string was too short or lacked the '6304' tag.

merchantCity.description: Receiver city from EMVCo tag 60. Null when absent.

merchantName.description: Receiver name from EMVCo tag 59. Null when absent.

pixKey.description: Receiver PIX key from EMVCo subtag 26-01. Null when the code omits it.

providedCrc.description: The four hexadecimal checksum digits carried by the code, upper-cased.

valid.description: true only when the recomputed checksum matches the one carried by the code. On a malformed payload this is the only field present besides error.

processingTimeMs.description: Edge processing time in milliseconds, excluding payment settlement. Mirrored in the X-Processing-Time-Ms response header.

success.description: true when the request was processed and paid for, independently of the checksum verdict.

suggestedNextSteps.description: Chaining hints for autonomous agents: sibling paid APIs in the same suite that are commonly called right after this one. Purely advisory, never required.

endpoint.description: Absolute HTTPS endpoint of the suggested follow-up API.

priceUsdc.description: Price of the suggested follow-up call, in USDC.

tool.description: Tool name of the suggested follow-up API.

when.description: Condition under which the follow-up call is worth making.

title: Decode and checksum-audit a PIX copy-and-paste BRCode
